metadata.description: Crew: a standing team of expert colleagues for your projects, each a subagent with a profile, a memory and a todo: hire them, run review rounds, hand them tasks, talk with them one-to-one or in meetings.

plugins.name: crew
plugins.description: Crew: set up a team of expert colleagues, hire, fire and portray them, run review rounds, hand them tasks by priority, talk with them one-to-one or in meetings; the Crew panel shows the team, their work and reports, their tasks and the meetings, and works with the project plugin's backlog.
